coverHistory.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One 1536x1024 landscape natural-history editorial photograph, one adult male great spotted woodpecker Dendrocopos major clinging upright to the left face of a narrow vertical birch trunk at right, black and white plumage, white shoulder patches, red undertail and small red nape, stiff tail touching bark, pointed bill. Cover composition: ENTIRE animal including all appendages and carried object within small box x=1050..1200 y=320..450 pixels, animal center at 73 percent width and 38 percent height. Wide habitat view, left 40% quiet real background. All subject edges surrounded by generous background. Soft natural light, realistic anatomy and textures. No text, logo, watermark, collage or additional animals.

Edit this species cover for a responsive website hero. Keep the same species, anatomy, pose and photographic style. Zoom OUT dramatically: the COMPLETE animal plus all visible appendages (and carried leaf if ant) must fit entirely inside x=1080..1220, y=320..440 on the 1536x1024 output. Animal center about 75% width and 37% height. Animal should occupy only about 9% image width and 12% image height. Rebuild seamless real habitat around it, no pasted rectangle, no blur patch. For woodpecker retain a continuous tree trunk supporting the feet and tail; for ant retain a continuous twig. For guinea pig use a spacious domestic garden lawn background with distant wooden shelter, not a wild mountain landscape. No other animals, no text, no borders. Make animal MUCH SMALLER than reference. Output 1536x1024.
